verdicts.note: Self-describes as 'the only girl'; clearly female.
Explicitly 'a mixed school'.
States she is in third year.
'only thing I wanted to do was music' supports strong interest.
Had an idea of careers; disagrees she chose with little knowledge.
Parents are musicians and influenced her, but they 'don't work with music' (industry tie thin); keep agree, lower confidence.
'Taught music from a young age' is a musical, not technical, hobby; does not support technical-nature construct.
Quote downplays the degree vs experience; does not support degree being valuable even if not entering profession.
No discouragement mentioned; determined free choice supports 'no'.
'Yeah definitely' to being pleased she chose the course.
Multimedia she'd never use yet had to do supports difficulty seeing relevance.
Quote is about people skills a good technician needs (field requirement), not about the COURSE developing interpersonal skills.
Lecturers 'very approachable' supports satisfaction with lecturer support.
Personal tutor effectively absent ('don't know who it is'); very dissatisfied is inferred, not emotionally expressed; lower confidence.
'Depends on your group' supports a mixed/neither view.
Names studio/practical work as a best part; supports satisfied.
'A good mixture of things' supports satisfaction with variety.
Did not go on placement; offered placements unsuitable.
'Factory work... nothing to do with music' supports work did not appeal.
Having to move to London is a location deterrent, but quote emphasises cost; keep agree, lower confidence.
Would have gone for interesting work; indirect support for valuing experience; thin.
Business/industry side is not a listed engineering area; 'other' fits.
Wants to run her own thing/business; managerial orientation.
'Important but just a bonus, not what I'll look for' supports middling importance.
Quote is a personal gap-year travel plan, separated from career; not travel opportunities as a job-choice factor.
Aware earning will be slow/low; high salary was not a draw; disagree fits.
